verification: The 23 selected primary posting URLs returned HTTP 200 and displayed application content. Eight accepted logo files were read through the shared company-logo operation, decoded as PNG and independently checked against the verified SHA-256. The isolated public workspace contains the operation receipts.
scope_notes: Vacancy and licence decisions remain with the user. Candidate work rights, location eligibility and sponsorship are unknown unless the employer explicitly supplies a term.

Each selected employer’s complete employer-board payload was screened for the target city and engineering scope. The checked source lists use published locations, including alternative cities where applicable.

Jane Street has a general evergreen Software Engineer listing (4274814002) and an additional internship listing with the same display title (8589868002). The more specific current non-internship listing (8647260002) represents this broad hiring route. Excluded compiler, hardware, IT operations and cyber vacancies have materially different specialist scopes.

Palantir’s undergraduate and government clearance-specific routes and specialist roles for Query Engines, Substrate, AI, and senior core infrastructure were excluded. The Forward Deployed Engineer feed lists a very old publisher date and remains accessible on the current employer and posting pages.

Lendable’s separately titled Senior Python Engineer (Full Stack) lists eight years and substantially overlaps its Senior Full Stack Engineer advert, so only the role without that explicit threshold is retained. Excluded Kotlin-specific, PHP 8/CQRS, dbt, and hands-on agent roles contain requirements unestablished by the public résumé.

Taktile advertises the two forward-deployed levels as separate openings with different requirements (2+ versus 4–6 years of engineering including customer-facing work). Its Platform full-stack opening specifically asks for five years building Python services. Atlas requires seven years, and Developer Experience asks for CI/CD and agent adoption at organisational scale. The Ops forward-deployed role asks for technical support to direct enterprise customers.

Kombo Developer Support Engineer is classified with Engineering and explicitly requires shipping production code, making direct fixes and writing features and tooling. Kombo Pre-Sales Engineer is a commercial position and is outside the cohort.

Almedia’s Junior DevOps-track and Data Engineering vacancies grant production ownership, name no experience ceiling and ask for demonstrated fundamentals. They remain junior in title and level. Its Senior Frontend opening explicitly requires seven or more React/TypeScript years. Its AI Full Stack role mandates experience building complex agentic systems. Its Senior Backend role specifies production experience with most of its stack, which the public résumé does not establish.

Other checked employer leads did not establish the combination of an eligible local set and an accepted official mark. The source inventory includes inaccessible brands, endpoints returning missing or empty boards, and companies screened out for seniority, specialist scope or geographic mismatch.
